subject.title: fix: block no-auth managed gateway LAN installs

question: Should OpenClaw accept an earlier managed-install failure for explicit no-auth non-loopback Gateway configs?
rationale: The code appears correct for the narrowed bug, but the earlier fail-closed point is an intentional compatibility/auth boundary change that maintainers should own.

options.title: Accept the preflight
options.body: Land the narrowed guard so invalid managed installs stop before service rewrite, matching the existing runtime refusal with better remediation.

options.title: Require broader service proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Windows Scheduled Task or equivalent managed-service run before accepting the compatibility change.

options.title: Pause for update-root-cause proof
options.body: Leave the PR paused if maintainers only want a fix after the broader update mutation path is reproduced.

recommendation.title: Accept the preflight
recommendation.body: Land the narrowed guard so invalid managed installs stop before service rewrite, matching the existing runtime refusal with better remediation.
